public.text: REDDHI is expanded as “Resilient Essential Data and Digital Health Infrastructure,” but the relationship among “resilient,” “essential,” “data,” and “digital health infrastructure” remains linguistically and conceptually unclear.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a short explanation that identifies which capabilities are essential, which properties make them resilient, and how data infrastructure differs from the wider digital-health infrastructure.
